Dim. & Name & Question \\
\midrule
D01 & Permission model & Does the harness ask before risky tool actions, and can the approve-everything path be restricted? \\
D02 & Execution sandbox & Is agent-executed code confined by an OS/container/VM boundary, and is that on by default? \\
D03 & Network egress control & Can outbound traffic from agent tools be limited to approved destinations? \\
D04 & Workspace and config trust & Is repository-supplied configuration (hooks, MCP, settings, rules, plugins) ignored until the user consents? \\
D05 & MCP governance & How are MCP servers and tools approved, restricted and monitored for change? \\
D06 & Extensions, skills and plugins & Is there vetting, scoping, pinning and policy control for installable extensions? \\
D07 & Secrets and credential storage & Are credentials and secrets stored, redacted and protected from the agent? \\
D08 & Headless and CI safeguards & Are non-interactive modes and official CI integrations safe by default against untrusted input? \\
D09 & Persistent memory & Is persistent memory scoped, visible, user-editable and controllable? \\
D10 & Sub-agent and delegation isolation & Do sub-agents and delegated harnesses inherit more authority than intended? \\
D11 & Audit logging & Can an organisation reconstruct what the agent did? \\
D12 & Telemetry and data retention & Is vendor-side data collection controllable and documented? (Policy choice; not a vulnerability.) \\
D13 & Distribution supply chain & Can users verify what they install and control updates? \\
D14 & Managed and enterprise policy & Can an organisation enforce settings that users and repositories cannot override? \\
D15 & Vulnerability disclosure & Does the vendor publish a security policy and advisories? \\
D16 & Local service and control-plane exposure (PROPOSED) & Do local or network services of the harness require authentication and validate Origin/Host? \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
